description: Hook-lane capability envelopes (ADR-0033, INV-03b). Every automatic caller of ops/memory/control_plane_client.py names its surface; the client refuses, client-side and before any process is spawned, an operation, record class, record count or byte size outside that surface's envelope (REJECTED, error 'REJECTED:envelope ...') and stamps principal.type=hook / principal.surface=<id> into the integration receipt. Bounded means the same MemoryService, the same admission and the same store with a narrower envelope — never an alternate path. Agents are NOT on this list: the agent lane is the package's public l9-memory / MCP surface and Cursor-Governance does not mediate it. A client constructed without a surface is the operator form (python -m ops.memory.cli by a human, legacy reconciliation, diagnostics) and carries principal.type=operator.
native_principal_follow_on: Preferred long-term form is a native hook principal on the l9-graphite-memory stdio door (signed agent assertion + grants JSON). Until the package ships one, this client-side envelope is the interim; it is a request against the package, not a Cursor-Governance expansion.
agent_lane_note: Production modules that read or write memory ON BEHALF OF AN AGENT (a PE worker's own task, a model tool). They use the package's public surface (l9-memory CLI located via ops.memory.runtime_binding, or the l9-graphite-memory MCP server) and never construct MemoryControlPlaneClient or spawn ops.memory.cli. ops/scripts/validate_memory_egress_boundary.py --lanes enforces this; tests/ops/memory/test_hook_envelope.py places every other caller.

callers: ops/hooks/pr_publish_memory_write.py (python -m ops.memory.cli --surface pr-publish write --kind pickup_context -> episodic + tag session_continuation)

record_class_note: Record classes are the canonical memory_class values as they reach l9-memory (after ops.memory.cli KIND_ALIASES: pickup_context->episodic (+ tag session_continuation; a continuation is tag-selected, not a MemoryClass), lesson->procedural, note->observation, rule->decision). A governed candidate is checked on knowledge.primary_class, where session_continuation is the capsule class; a distill is bounded by memory's own extractor, so record_classes does not apply to it.
max_bytes_note: max_bytes bounds one call's payload: write content, the serialized governed candidate, the close summary, or the redacted distill source file (MEMORY_CLOSE_TRANSCRIPT_CHARS chars, so session-end surfaces allow 64 KiB). max_records is a per-client-instance tally of committed records (write / ingest_candidate / close count 1; distill counts the receipt's written_count). Read-only surfaces declare 0/0.
